info.name: Verifiable API Documentation Alerts Audit API

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: type
params.description: If set, only returns events with the specified type. More than 1 type can be specified.

params.name: includeFailedRequests
params.description: If set to `true`, also includes failed request events (these are filtered out by default). Note that not all failed requests can be captured or assigned to your organization, depending on the nature of the failure.

params.name: entityId
params.description: If set, only returns events related to the specified identifier. For example, to filter on events for a given provider, set this parameter to the identifier of that provider. More than 1 entity identifier can be specified.

params.name: category
params.description: If set, only returns events related to the specified category. More than 1 category can be specified.

params.name: subcategory
params.description: If set, only returns events related to the specified subcategory. The subcategories differ per `category`. More than 1 subcategory can be specified.

params.name: before
params.description: If set, only returns events from before this date.

params.name: beforeInclusive
params.description: If set to `true`, will include events created exactly at `before` date and time too.

params.name: after
params.description: If set, only returns events from after this date.

params.name: afterInclusive
params.description: If set to `true`, will include events created exactly at `after` date and time too.

params.name: correlationId
params.description: If set, only returns events related to the specified correlation identifier.

params.name: sortedBy
params.description: The property by which the returned data will be sorted.

params.name: sort
params.description: If set, the properties and directions the returned data will be sorted by.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the page to start.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The cursor to render the page requested. To load the first page send an empty cursor, then the system will generate the cursors to go to the next and/or previous pages automatically.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of items to include in a single page.

items.docs: Returns a page of event log entries. Events can occur either system or user initiated. In case an event is user initiated the event context contains information on the user that triggered it and the associated HTTP request is captured.
